triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue is a localized logic fix in model resolution and configuration handling in packages/core/src/config/models.ts and config.ts to properly normalize deprecated model alias 'auto-gemini-2.5' before making backend API calls.

summary.problem: The CLI fails with API Error 400 Bad Request 'Request contains an invalid argument' when configured with the legacy model alias 'auto-gemini-2.5'.
summary.root_cause: The deprecated model alias 'auto-gemini-2.5' (DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL_AUTO) is not normalized or resolved to a valid concrete model name (such as 'gemini-2.5-pro') before requests are sent to the Cloud Code backend streamGenerateContent endpoint.
summary.context: In packages/core/src/config/models.ts, resolveModel handles DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL_AUTO, but in certain execution or dynamic configuration paths, the un-resolved 'auto-gemini-2.5' string is passed in request payloads/headers, leading to a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT error from the API server.

steps: Update resolveModel and dynamic model resolution services in packages/core/src/config/models.ts to ensure 'auto-gemini-2.5' is consistently normalized to 'gemini-2.5-pro' across all model resolution Contexts.
Update default configuration getters in packages/core/src/config/config.ts to avoid setting or defaulting to un-resolvable legacy model alias strings.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Resolving 'auto-gemini-2.5' returns 'gemini-2.5-pro' without leaving the deprecated alias string in outgoing API request parameters.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases in packages/core/src/config/models.test.ts verifying that resolveModel('auto-gemini-2.5') and resolveClassifierModel('auto-gemini-2.5', ...) return valid model IDs under all feature flag contexts.
Run Vitest on models.test.ts to verify that all model resolution tests pass.
